name: Dumbbell Seated Calf Raise
steps: Sit on a bench with feet flat and steady a dumbbell on each thigh just above the knee.
Press through the balls of both feet to raise your heels as high as you comfortably can.
Lower your heels smoothly to the floor.
tips: Keep the dumbbells clear of your kneecaps.
Pause briefly at peak height and lower smoothly without bouncing your heels.
